name: Island Pizza Company
description: Fresh pizza by the slice featuring local ingredients. Pepperoni, Hawaiian, and veggie options available.

description: Board games, educational toys, and STEM kits. Perfect gifts for curious minds of all ages.

name: Local Artist Collective
description: Original artwork, prints, and crafts from Hawaii artists. Unique pieces celebrating island culture and technology.

name: STEM Book Corner
description: Curated selection of science, technology, engineering, and math books for all reading levels.
